Fresh independent robot-model comparison

These are saved simulated episodes from independently trained affine-flow and mechanics-aware NODE models. Both models are tested with fine and coarse internal queries. All four controllers receive fresh observations and choose commands every40 ms. The actuator has a known80 ms lag. See the accompanying report for aggregate effects and uncertainty; a selected episode alone cannot establish superiority.

Dashed red arms show the target. Playback follows physical motion time. Planning time is CPU computation between observations, measured separately.
